preprocessing: BGR8 to RGB float32 NCHW /255; bilinear STRETCH to 640x640
decoder: YOLOv8 xywh in model pixels, two class scores, no objectness, class-aware NMS
backend: TensorRT 10, target-built FP16 engine with float32 linear device I/O
